ES Kiosk operating system baseline

Intune profile: APM-W11-SEC-Baseline-ESKiosk-P-1.0. Copy of the corporate Windows 11 security baseline APM-W11-SEC-Baseline-P-1.2 with ten control rows adjusted so the device signs in unattended and runs an uninterrupted participant session. Every other control is inherited from the corporate baseline without change.
Partial - ES exception. Corporate additional hardening. Not applied: the session ends by restart rather than by lock, so no screen saver is permitted to interrupt it.
ES EXCEPTION 1 - was Enabled.

Partial - ES exception. ASD requires a password-protected screen saver. Not applied: no participant holds a credential, so a locked screen could not be cleared and the device would be unusable until a technician attended. Compensated by the ten-minute inactivity restart, which destroys the session rather than concealing it.
ES EXCEPTION 2 - was Enabled.
Partial - ES exception. Corporate additional hardening. Not applied: the screen saver timer is superseded by the ten-minute inactivity restart.
ES EXCEPTION 3 - was Enabled.
Not configured
Partial - ES exception. Corporate additional hardening. Value removed with its parent setting.

Not configured

Partial - ES exception. ASD and Microsoft require automatic restart sign-on to be disabled. Not managed by this baseline: the device signs in unattended after every restart, which is the mechanism that returns a purged device to service. Compensated by the session account holding no credential known to any person, and by App Control enforcement.
ES EXCEPTION 4 - was Disabled, now removed from the policy. Confirm on the reference device: DisableAutomaticRestartSignOn and AutoAdminLogon are separate mechanisms.

Partial - ES exception. ASD and Microsoft require a password on wake. Not applied: no participant holds a credential, so a wake prompt makes the device unusable. Compensated by the restart-based session purge and by the device holding no participant data at rest.
ES EXCEPTION 5 - was Enabled.
Partial - ES exception. As for the battery setting above. Not applied: no participant holds a credential to satisfy a wake prompt.
ES EXCEPTION 6 - was Enabled.

Partial - ES exception. ASD requires the Secure Attention Sequence before logon. Not applied: no participant is present at boot to press it, so the device would never reach a session. Compensated by Assigned Access restricting the session to an allow-listed application set with no shell, and by the device being physically supervised in an APM site.
ES EXCEPTION 7 - was Disabled.

Partial - ES exception. ASD and Microsoft require an inactivity lock. Not applied: a lock screen cannot be cleared without a credential. Compensated by the ten-minute inactivity restart, which destroys the profile rather than concealing it. Open with APM Cyber Security: this removes the failsafe lock if the watchdog fails.
